archetype_descriptions.frozen: no design change is proposed after the first run
archetype_descriptions.saturating: the loop keeps moving but the outcome never changes
archetype_descriptions.converging: the outcome improves and the step size decays
archetype_descriptions.overshooting: the outcome improves after at least one reversal in direction
archetype_descriptions.oscillating: direction reverses repeatedly without a sustained improvement

constant.note: the training mean; the floor any real model must clear

ARS only.note: one logistic in the CO2 coverage, O2 ignored

OGS only.note: one logistic in the O2 coverage, CO2 ignored

Liebig on coverage.note: logistic in min(rho_ARS, rho_OGS): the law of the minimum as usually stated

Liebig on margin.note: the same law after dividing each coverage by its own critical value

series (product).note: the two subsystems in series, survival as the product of their responses

Liebig on response.note: the binding subsystem sets the outcome: min of the two responses
